WITH doctor_missed_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        d.id AS doctor_id,
        d.name AS doctor_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'missed' THEN 1 END) AS missed_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_appointments
    FROM 
        doctors d
    JOIN 
        appointments a ON d.id = a.doctor_id
    GROUP BY 
        d.id, d.name
)
SELECT 
    doctor_name,
    CAST(missed_count AS REAL) / total_appointments AS missed_ratio
FROM 
    doctor_missed_ratio
ORDER BY 
    missed_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

WITH ordered_appointments AS (
    SELECT 
        day,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day) AS rn
    FROM 
        appointments
    WHERE 
        patient_id = 3
)
SELECT 
    day,
    CASE 
        WHEN rn = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE julianday(day) - julianday((SELECT day FROM ordered_appointments WHERE rn = rn - 1))
    END AS days_since_previous
FROM 
    ordered_appointments
ORDER BY 
    day;
```

    FROM shipments
